items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The change is one line plus a short comment ('# Ensure base table is in the query.'), and it matches the reference solution almost word for word.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing query.get_initial_alias() helper inside single_alias. Collector and QuerySet.delete are untouched, and there is no duplicated logic or dead code.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It is a minimal, idempotent call that adds no new error paths. It introduces no exception handling, magic constants or resource handling. Hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in single_alias by calling get_initial_alias() before counting aliases. The agent checked the generated SQL: joined and filtered deletes still use the IN (SELECT U0.id ...) subquery. There is no special case for one backend, so the MySQL compiler benefits too.
